name: Iconbuddy
summary: Search engine for 300,000+ open source SVG icons with colour, size and SVG/PNG/JSX/Base64 export.
description: Iconbuddy indexes 300,000+ free SVG icons from open source libraries such as Lucide, Heroicons, Tabler, Phosphor, Material Symbols and Font Awesome. Icons can be searched, recoloured, resized and exported as SVG, PNG, JSX or Base64; plugins for Figma, VS Code, Framer, WordPress and Chrome expose the same library, and an MCP server plus REST API hand icons to coding agents.
contains: plugins for Figma, VS Code, Framer, WordPress and Chrome
MCP server on npm plus REST API for coding agents
